materials_exhausted.note: Bounded re-review opened the primary XML/PDF, packet extraction surfaces, local supplement text, OA package locators, and linked database snapshots. Remaining limitations are preserved as cautions rather than open blocking tickets.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2 rebuilt all primary XML Tables 2-5 core activity/toxicity rows, worker-5 replaced automated mechanism placeholders with source-classified direct, phenotype, and computational mechanism claims, and worker-6 accepts with cautions because database-level conflicts remain explicitly preserved rather than hidden.
summary: Publication-grade with cautions after bounded source re-review: activity/toxicity rows now cover the 378 core XML-supported rows, mechanism ontology is source-adjudicated, and database conflicts remain transparent caution findings.

semantic_quality_checks.supplementary_checked: Supplement text was checked for Table S1 and Figures S3-S10; Table S1 is retained as selectivity-index context and supplement figures support mechanism locator coverage where cited.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions. DRAMP rows with explicit name/sequence/source support remain source_verified; DBAASP/CAMP rows with blank, partial, or undefined database naming/modification fields remain source_conflict with conflict context preserved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted. Worker-2 rebuilt Tables 2-4 as 112 MIC, 112 MBEC, and 112 MBIC peptide-organism rows and Table 5 as 42 HC50/IC50 toxicity rows; group means, p-values, and SI were excluded from the core row count.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with ontology cautions. Direct permeabilization/depolarization/microscopy evidence is scoped to selected peptides and organisms, CG MD is computational_only, and activity tables are phenotype_supported only.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_6_adjudication: Accepted_with_cautions after worker-2/5 repair and strict gate rerun; no blocking or major rework targets remain open.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP/CAMP rows can be linked to source sequence/activity patterns, but blank/undefined local database naming or non-row-normalized text prevents promotion of every row to source_verified.
Direct membrane assays and microscopy are for L2/C2/L4/C4 and selected organisms/cells; they do not prove direct mechanism for every L1-C7 table entry.
Coarse-grained MD membrane binding/local perturbation evidence is retained as computational_only and not promoted to direct mechanism.

last_gate_results.interpretation: Strict semantic and publication-quality gates passed after final artifact/status recording.
